description:
Updates a DNS record

HTTP: PATCH /v1/dns/records/:id
Category: DNS
Required scopes: dns:write
Returns: {status, data: object {id, zone_id, type, name, content, ttl, priority, weight, port, auth, external_record_id, disabled, … (+4 more)}}
Mutating: changes server state.

content.description: New record value; unchanged when omitted (private/reserved IPs are rejected for A/AAAA)

name.description: New host name; unchanged when omitted

priority.description: New MX/SRV priority; unchanged when omitted

ttl.description: New time to live in seconds; unchanged when omitted or 0

name: panelica_dns_patch_v1_dns_records_id
